titulo: CBS News Amazed by Accuracy of GTA 6, Highlights Miami Similarities in New Report
texto: CBS News has reported on the accuracy of GTA 6’s Vice City, a fictionalized recreation of The Magic City. The Miami office of CBS News looked at major locations and brings on experts to talk about how accurate Rockstar’s open world is, from PortMiami to South Beach, Wynwood to the Everglades.

titulo: GTA 6 Wants Losing Your Wanted Level To Feel Like A “Hit-And-Run”
texto: Gamers hoping for GTA 6 to amp up the realism when it comes to losing their wanted level in the sunny state of Leonida are in luck, with Rockstar confirming in a recent interview that Jason and Lucia can do far more than escape a glowing red zone on the map to shake off the law.  Speaking to IGN ahead of the Netflix Extended Look back in August, head of development and co-studio head Rob Nelson walked the outlet through a 30-minute gameplay demo in which several new mechanics and locations were detailed. The demo begins in Jason and Lucia’s safehouse, one of many interactive personal spaces the player can call home in GTA 6. Here you can switch characters, partake in unique interactions, or even decorate the place to suit your style. titulo: New Details Revealed For GTA 6’s Jason And Lucia, Including “Physical Intimacy”
texto: New information has come to light about GTA 6 , and specifically the partnership of its main characters, Jason and Lucia . In GTA 6, they are both partners in crime and lovers, and physical intimacy will be part of the experience, it seems. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said in an interview with IGN that physical intimacy is a "huge part" of a relationship, and that applies to GTA 6. Exactly how this may operate in GTA 6, however, remains a mystery. "It has to be done right," Nelson said. "Like anything that we do, we have to iterate and try things and iterate on it until we figure out what feels right," he explained. Lucia and Jason in GTA 6.
